searchText: just an fyi if you're trying to run the lighthouse epbs branch you'll also need to include this flag `--epochs-per-migration 99999` can you explain what is this flag doing? It sounds like a hack for now? We haven’t updated our cold db to handle post block vs post payload envelope states yet. This flag prevents LH from migrating data to the cold db. you might see an uptick in disk space usage because of this. but this should be negligible for short lived devnets added it to to the notes page so ppl are aware of this Are other clients planning to blind their payloads to save disk space and rely on `engine_getPayloadBodiesBy*` to reconstruct them? Blinding payloads to save disk space Do you guys have sync ready or are you going to rely on the devnet not crashing? I think Prysm will get there to start the devnet, but I don't think we'll be able to sync at all if we crash/stop yessir, if I click there will you solve sync? Did the EL devs changed the payload type on ePBS? nvm, it may still be my problem 🙁
